description: Set up BrowserStack App Automate SDK integration for Appium-based mobile app testing. ONLY for Appium based framework . This tool configures SDK for various languages with appium. For pre-built Espresso or XCUITest test suites, use 'runAppTestsOnBrowserStack' instead.

appPath.description: Path to the mobile app file (.apk for Android, .ipa for iOS). Can be a local file path or a BrowserStack app URL (bs://)

detectedFramework.description: The mobile automation framework configured in the project. Example: 'appium'

detectedLanguage.description: The programming language used in the project. Supports Java and C#. Example: 'java', 'csharp'

detectedTestingFramework.description: The testing framework used in the project. Be precise with framework selection Example: 'testng', 'behave', 'pytest', 'robot'

devices.description: Tuples describing target mobile devices. Add device only when user asks explicitly for it. Defaults to [] . Example: [['android', 'Samsung Galaxy S24', '14'], ['ios', 'iPhone 15', '17']]

deviceName.description: Device name, e.g. 'Samsung Galaxy S24', 'Google Pixel 8', 'iPhone 15', 'iPhone 14 Pro'

project.description: Project name for organizing test runs on BrowserStack.

name: setupBrowserStackAppAutomateTests
